title: Aether Internal Authorization Context
description: Draft server-to-server context created only after trusted authentication, current tenant membership resolution, resource ownership validation, and an allow decision. Never accept this object from an external client as proof of authorization.

tenant_id.description: Resolved from trusted canonical membership state; never copied directly from client input.

decision.description: Only an allow decision may produce this context. Denials use a separate safe error/audit path.

membership_version.description: Version or revision returned by the canonical membership authority; exact version semantics remain a product decision.

resource_acl_version.description: Version of the authoritative resource ACL used for this decision.

expires_at.description: Short-lived context expiry. Exact lifetime must be approved per operation class.

approval_id.description: Optional reference to a separately verified approval bound to this exact action and resource.
